text.p: Marie is extratropical. It has now crossed the dateline and continues to move towards the east-northeast.

Tropical storm Andres has formed in the eastern Pacific well to the south of Acapulco. Top winds are 40 mph at this time but they may increase to 55 mph during the next 24-48 hours. Movement will be towards the north and then northeast during this period. This system will mainly impact shipping during the next 24-36 hours but it may threaten the southeast coast of Mexico later in the period.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
